title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 2,801–2,850 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 錦標賽；聯賽；錦標錦標賽

examples.en: The Taipei Open badminton tournament draws Olympic gold medalists annually.
examples.zh: 台北羽球公開賽錦標賽每年吸引多位奧運金牌得主齊聚較勁。

examples.en: She advanced through several elimination rounds to reach the tennis tournament finals.
examples.zh: 她一路過關斬將闖過數輪殘酷淘汰賽，昂首挺進網球錦標賽總決賽。

examples.en: The university chess club hosted an intercollegiate tournament over the weekend.
examples.zh: 大學西洋棋社在週末期間主辦了一場規模盛大的校際西洋棋聯賽。

words.definition: 冠軍頭銜；總冠軍賽；錦標賽

examples.en: The baseball team claimed the CPBL annual championship trophy.
examples.zh: 這支職棒強隊勇奪中華職棒（CPBL）年度總冠軍最高榮耀。

examples.en: Years of intense practice culminated in her winning the national swimming championship.
examples.zh: 多年如一日的嚴苛苦練，終於迎來了她在全國游泳錦標賽一舉摘冠的高光時刻。

examples.en: The thrilling overtime battle decided who would take home the championship ring.
examples.zh: 這場緊張到令人屏息的延長賽大戰，最終決定了誰能將最高榮耀的總冠軍戒指帶回家。

examples.en: Dedicated track athletes train tirelessly in rain and shine.
examples.zh: 專注自律的田徑運動員無論晴雨皆持之以恆投入高強度體能訓練。

examples.en: Professional athletes maintain strict nutritional diets and rigid sleep schedules.
examples.zh: 頂級職業運動員對個人日常營養攝取維持苛刻標準，並嚴格恪守規律作息。

examples.en: The injured athlete underwent intensive physical therapy to prepare for the Olympics.
examples.zh: 這名受傷的體育健兒積極投入密集的高階物理復健，期盼趕在奧運開幕前重返賽場。

words.definition: 巨蛋體育場；大型體育館

examples.en: Thousands of fans filled the Taipei Dome stadium for the international friendly.
examples.zh: 數萬名熱血球迷湧入台北大巨蛋觀看精彩的國際棒球邀請賽。

examples.en: The newly renovated baseball stadium features upgraded seating, lighting, and locker rooms.
examples.zh: 全新翻修竣工的棒球場全面升級了觀眾看台座椅、球場夜間照明以及球員專屬休息室。

examples.en: The pop singer announced two sold-out concerts at the national sports stadium.
examples.zh: 流行樂壇天后正式對外公布，將在國家體育場連開兩場門票秒殺一空的萬人大型巡迴演唱會。

examples.en: Over forty thousand cheering spectators created an electrifying atmosphere.
examples.zh: 超過四萬名齊聲吶喊的現場觀眾營造出熱血沸騰的震撼氛圍。

examples.en: Spectators were asked to remain quiet during the decisive tennis match points.
examples.zh: 在網球決定勝負的關鍵冠軍點時刻，現場司儀特別呼籲全場觀賽者務必保持絕對安靜。

examples.en: Heavy rain did not deter enthusiastic spectators from packing the stands to watch the marathon.
examples.zh: 傾盆大雨絲毫無法澆熄狂熱觀眾的熱情，看台上依舊擠滿了前來為馬拉松跑者加油的群眾。

words.definition: 裁判；執法裁判；擔任裁判

examples.en: The basketball referee blew the whistle to signal a foul.
examples.zh: 籃球執法裁判果斷鳴響哨音示意場上球員發生防守犯規。

examples.en: The soccer referee showed a red card to the defender for an intentional hand ball.
examples.zh: 足球場上的主裁判果斷向那名故意手球犯規的後衛出示紅牌、將其驅逐出場。

examples.en: It takes mental toughness to be an impartial referee when home crowds boo your decisions.
examples.zh: 在滿場主場球迷對著判決狂噓鼓譟的巨大壓力下，擔任一名鐵面無私的公正裁判需要極強的心理素質。

examples.en: Look up at the giant LED scoreboard to see game highlights.
examples.zh: 抬頭看著中央巨型 LED 電子計分板即可重溫剛才的精彩慢動作重播。

examples.en: The scoreboard flashed the final score as fans erupted into deafening cheers.
examples.zh: 當電子計分螢幕定格顯示最終比賽比分時，全場主場球迷瞬間爆發出震耳欲聾的勝利歡呼。

examples.en: A technical glitch on the digital scoreboard temporarily confused both teams regarding the remaining time.
examples.zh: 數位計分板突如其來的短暫電子故障，一度讓場上對壘的雙方球員對剩餘比賽時間感到困惑。

words.definition: 半場休息；中場休息時間

examples.en: Marching bands performed dynamic music during the halftime show.
examples.zh: 樂旗隊在中場半場休息時間帶來了氣勢磅礴的動感音樂演奏表演。

examples.en: The coach gave an inspiring motivational speech in the locker room during halftime.
examples.zh: 總教練在中場休息時間踏入球員更衣室，發表了一席慷慨激昂、鼓舞士氣的談話。

examples.en: Grab a hot dog and a drink during halftime before the third quarter begins.
examples.zh: 趁著半場休息時間趕快去球場走道買份熱狗堡與無糖飲料，準備迎接下半場第三節激戰。

examples.en: The basketball game tied in regulation and went into overtime.
examples.zh: 雙方在正規比賽時間打成平手，比賽隨即進入緊張刺激的延長賽。

examples.en: The software engineer worked three hours of overtime every evening to deploy the critical patch.
examples.zh: 為了在期限前緊急發布關鍵系統修補程式，這名軟體工程師每天傍晚自願加班三小時。

examples.en: A buzzer-beater shot in triple overtime sealed an unforgettable championship victory.
examples.zh: 在歷經三次延長賽的慘烈鏖戰後，一顆讀秒絕殺壓哨球為球隊鎖定了載入史冊的總冠軍勝利。

words.definition: 勝利的；凱旋的；耀武揚威的

examples.en: The triumphant team paraded through city streets waving to ecstatic fans.
examples.zh: 凱旋榮歸的冠軍隊伍在市區盛大遊行，向夾道狂歡的球迷揮手致意。

examples.en: She flashed a triumphant smile after breaking the longstanding school swimming record.
examples.zh: 在奮力打破高懸多年的全校游泳歷史紀錄後，她對著看台綻放出一抹勝利自豪的燦爛笑容。

examples.en: The army made a triumphant return to the capital following months of defensive warfare.
examples.zh: 在歷經數月艱苦卓絕的邊境防衛戰後，英勇受閱的軍隊邁著整齊步伐凱旋榮歸首都接受歡呼。

examples.en: Finishing as the world tournament runner-up was an incredible achievement.
examples.zh: 在競爭激烈的世界大賽中榮獲亞軍殊榮已是一項無比非凡的重大成就。

examples.en: Although disappointed to finish as runner-up, the tennis star vowed to come back stronger next year.
examples.zh: 儘管屈居亞軍難免令人感到遺憾，但這位網球名將誓言明年定將以更強大的姿態重返巔峰。

examples.en: The silver medal went to the runner-up, who finished just a fraction of a second behind the winner.
examples.zh: 銀牌頒發給了第二名亞軍得主，他在終點線前僅以幾百分之一秒的微弱差距惜敗於金牌冠軍。

examples.en: Gold, silver, and bronze medalists stood proudly on the award podium.
examples.zh: 金、銀、銅牌得主並肩自豪地挺身站在奧運頒獎台上接受喝采。

examples.en: Standing atop the Olympic podium as the national anthem played was the proudest moment of his life.
examples.zh: 當國旗歌莊嚴響徹全場、昂首佇立在奧運最高頒獎台上時，那是他此生最引以為傲的榮耀時刻。

examples.en: The company CEO walked up to the podium to deliver the keynote address at the annual summit.
examples.zh: 企業執行長邁著自信從容的步伐走上發言講台，在年度全球科技高峰會上發表重要主旨演講。

words.definition: 運動家精神；勝不驕敗不餒的風度

examples.en: Helping an injured opponent finish the race demonstrates true sportsmanship.
examples.zh: 停下腳步主動攙扶受傷的對手一同抵達終點展現了最純粹的運動家精神。

examples.en: The tennis player was praised for exemplary sportsmanship after conceding a disputed out ball.
examples.zh: 這名網球選手在對手提出爭議球時主動承認出界，其展現出的崇高運動員風度贏得全場喝采。

examples.en: Coaches emphasize that mutual respect and sportsmanship are far more important than winning trophies.
examples.zh: 總教練再三對青年選手諄諄教導：彼此尊重與勝不驕敗不餒的運動家精神，遠比獎盃更重要。

examples.en: The player received a technical foul for arguing with the referee.
examples.zh: 該名球員因向裁判過度激烈抗議判決而被吹判了一次技術犯規。

examples.en: The soccer striker was awarded a penalty kick after a severe foul inside the penalty box.
examples.zh: 足球隊主力前鋒在禁區內遭受對方後衛惡意嚴重犯規，當即為球隊贏得了一記十二碼罰球點球。

examples.en: The abandoned basement smelled strongly of foul damp air and decaying garbage.
examples.zh: 這處久無人居的荒廢地下室內，撲鼻而來的是一股極度刺鼻污濁的潮濕霉味與腐爛垃圾臭氣。

examples.en: The point guard sank both clutch free throws to win the game.
examples.zh: 明星控球後衛在關鍵時刻穩穩罰進兩顆罰球，一舉逆轉奪勝。

examples.en: Players practice hundreds of repetitions every day to achieve high free throw accuracy.
examples.zh: 職業籃球員每天在無人防守的罰球線上反覆練習投擲數百次，以淬煉出精準無比的罰球命中率。

examples.en: A technical foul gives the opposing team one uncontested free throw and possession of the ball.
examples.zh: 一旦被吹判技術犯規，對手隊伍將立即獲得一次無干擾輕鬆罰球機會以及接下來的前場球權。

examples.en: The Taipei International Marathon attracts tens of thousands of global runners.
examples.zh: 台北國際馬拉松大賽每年吸引數以萬計的全球長跑好手熱血開跑。

examples.en: Running an official 42-kilometer marathon requires months of structured weekly mileage training.
examples.zh: 想要順利完賽四十二公里的全馬馬拉松賽事，需要長達數月系統化且每週不間斷的漸進式跑量累積。

examples.en: The negotiations turned into a grueling twelve-hour marathon before a ceasefire was agreed upon.
examples.zh: 這場多方和平斡旋談判演變成了一場耗時長達十二個小時的持久馬拉松式談判，雙方才達成停火協議。

words.definition: 鐵人三項（游泳、單車、路跑）

examples.en: The Taitung Triathlon challenges endurance along the picturesque east coast.
examples.zh: 台東國際鐵人三項賽沿著風景如畫的東部海岸線挑戰極限體能耐力。

examples.en: Competing in a full Ironman triathlon involves swimming, cycling, and running in a single grueling day.
examples.zh: 報名參加一場極限大鐵超級鐵人三項賽，意味著必須在漫長的一天內依序完成游泳、自行車與路跑。

examples.en: She bought an aerodynamic road bike to improve her cycling split time during the upcoming triathlon.
examples.zh: 她特地添購了一輛頂級空氣動力學破風公路自行車，期盼在即將到來的鐵人三項賽中縮短騎乘分段時間。

examples.en: Long-distance cycling builds extraordinary cardiovascular stamina and endurance.
examples.zh: 長途公路自行車騎乘能鍛鍊出卓越超群的心肺耐力與堅韌毅力。

examples.en: Ultra-marathon runners push the absolute biological limits of human endurance.
examples.zh: 征戰極限百公里超馬的長跑名將，不斷用驚人意志力挑戰並刷新人類生理耐力的絕對極限。

examples.en: The ceramic brake pads demonstrated remarkable thermal endurance under repeated high-speed stops.
examples.zh: 頂級陶瓷煞車來令片在高頻繁的極速煞停摩擦高溫考驗下，展現出了令人驚嘆的耐熱持久性能。

examples.en: Thirty minutes of daily cardio keeps your heart and lungs healthy.
examples.zh: 每天進行三十分鐘中等強度的有氧心肺運動能常保心肺機能健康。

examples.en: Combining brisk walking with jump rope provides an effective low-impact cardio session.
examples.zh: 將戶外快走慢跑與輕快跳繩相互結合，能構成一組高效且不易磨損膝蓋關節的低衝擊有氧運動。

examples.en: You should always include cardio workouts in your fitness plan to manage blood pressure effectively.
examples.zh: 在規劃個人每週健身運動菜單時，應當適度融入有氧心肺訓練，以科學且長效地維持血壓穩定。

examples.en: Regular strength training increases bone density and builds lean muscle.
examples.zh: 規律進行肌力重量訓練能有效提升骨質密度並增加緊實精壯肌肉。

examples.en: Older adults benefit immensely from strength training because it helps prevent accidental falls.
examples.zh: 銀髮族長輩定期投入肌力阻力訓練能收穫巨大健康益處，因為它能極大幅度預防年長者意外跌倒。

examples.en: You don't need heavy machinery for strength training; bodyweight push-ups and squats are fantastic.
examples.zh: 進行肌力訓練並非一定非得仰賴昂貴器械，日常進行標準伏地挺身與自重深蹲即具備極佳鍛鍊效果。

examples.en: A proper ten-minute dynamic warm-up prevents unexpected muscle sprains.
examples.zh: 運動前先進行十分鐘充分的動態暖身熱身能有效預防肌肉拉傷扭傷。

examples.en: Jumping jacks, leg swings, and arm circles are popular exercises for an athletic warm-up.
examples.zh: 開合跳、鐘擺式擺腿以及雙臂大迴環伸展，皆是田徑運動員在賽前普遍採用的經典動態暖身動作。

examples.en: Skipping the warm-up before lifting heavy weights significantly increases your risk of joint injury.
examples.zh: 在進行大重量槓鈴深蹲臥推前若僥倖省略暖身環節，將會成倍拉高肌腱韌帶與關節意外受傷的風險。

examples.en: Never skip post-workout static stretching and cool-down routines.
examples.zh: 劇烈高強度運動訓練結束後，切勿略過靜態收操拉筋放鬆環節。

examples.en: A five-minute easy jog followed by deep stretching serves as an ideal post-race cool-down.
examples.zh: 進行五分鐘緩和慢跑並搭配全身各大肌群的深層靜態伸展，是賽後最理想的收操放鬆程序。

examples.en: A gradual cool-down allows your elevated heart rate to return gently to resting levels.
examples.zh: 循序漸進的緩和收操程序，能讓劇烈運動後飆升的心率與血壓平緩溫和地回落至日常靜態水準。

examples.en: Practicing yoga improves joint mobility and overall muscular flexibility.
examples.zh: 規律練習瑜珈能顯著改善關節活動度並大幅提升全身肌肉柔軟度。

examples.en: Gymnast routines demand incredible spinal flexibility and balance.
examples.zh: 體操競技選手在平衡木與地板動作上的高難度空翻，對脊椎腰部柔軟度與平衡感要求極高。

examples.en: Having schedule flexibility allows remote freelancers to exercise during midday off-peak hours.
examples.zh: 工作工時具備高度彈性與自由度，讓在家遠距辦公的自由工作者能在人潮較少的中午離峰時段運動。

words.definition: 體態姿勢；發力姿勢；姿態

examples.en: Maintaining proper spine posture while lifting weights prevents back injuries.
examples.zh: 重訓舉起槓鈴時維持正確脊椎中立體態姿勢能有效避免腰背受傷。

examples.en: Ergonomic desk chairs help desk workers correct poor sitting posture.
examples.zh: 挑選一張合格的人體工學辦公椅，能有效協助久坐辦公室的上班族糾正不良彎腰駝背坐姿。

examples.en: Slouching over your smartphone for hours leads to rounded shoulders and neck posture pain.
examples.zh: 低頭盯著智慧型手機螢幕長達數小時之久，容易引發圓肩駝背與後頸部體態痠痛發炎問題。

examples.en: Planks and Pilates effectively strengthen deep abdominal core muscles.
examples.zh: 棒式平板支撐與皮拉提斯運動能強效鍛鍊深層腹部核心肌群。

examples.en: Strong core muscles provide stability, preventing chronic lower back discomfort during long runs.
examples.zh: 擁有強健有力的核心肌群能為身體提供堅若磐石的穩定度，防止長跑時腰椎深處產生慢性不適。

examples.en: Engaging your core muscles before lifting a heavy box protects your lower back.
examples.zh: 在彎腰抱起沉重的快遞大紙箱前，先深吸一口氣收緊並啟動腹部核心肌群，能周密保護下背部。

examples.en: Delayed onset muscle soreness (DOMS) typically peaks two days after workouts.
examples.zh: 延遲性肌肉痠痛（DOMS）通常會在激烈運動後的第四十八小時達到高峰。

examples.en: Soaking in a warm hot spring bath soothed the painful muscular soreness in his calves.
examples.zh: 將疲憊的身軀完全浸泡在溫暖滑潤的天然溫泉池中，徹底舒緩了他雙腿小腿肌肉的腫脹痠痛。

examples.en: Expect mild muscle soreness after trying an unfamiliar exercise routine for the very first time.
examples.zh: 當您生平第一次嘗試一組此前從未練過的全新重訓動作課表時，隔天出現輕微肌肉痠痛實屬常態。

examples.en: Proper hydration is essential when hiking in humid sub-tropical climates.
examples.zh: 在悶熱潮濕的亞熱帶山林登山健行時，適時補足水分至關重要。

examples.en: Maintaining optimal cellular hydration keeps your skin glowing and prevents midday fatigue.
examples.zh: 維繫體內細胞水分充沛的最佳保濕補水狀態，能讓肌膚水潤透亮並徹底驅散午後的昏睡疲倦感。

examples.en: Runners set reminders on their GPS smartwatches to maintain steady water hydration throughout the race.
examples.zh: 專業長跑選手在智慧 GPS 運動手錶上設定定時提醒，確保整場賽程中每隔兩公里皆能按時定量補水。

examples.en: Drink electrolyte beverages to replenish sodium and potassium lost in sweat.
examples.zh: 飲用電解質運動飲料以即時補充電解質與隨大量汗水流失的鈉與鉀。

examples.en: Severe heat exhaustion depletes essential body electrolytes, causing painful cramps.
examples.zh: 在烈日下嚴重中暑虛脫會急劇耗盡人體維持神經傳導所需的電解質，進而誘發難忍的肌肉痙攣抽筋。

examples.en: Coconut water is a delicious natural beverage rich in hydrating minerals and electrolytes.
examples.zh: 天然純椰子水是一種富含人體所需微量礦物質與天然電解質的絕佳消暑生津補水飲品。

words.definition: 高蛋白飲品；乳清蛋白奶昔

examples.en: Fitness enthusiasts consume whey protein shakes post-workout for muscle repair.
examples.zh: 健身愛好者習慣在重訓課表結束後立即飲用乳清高蛋白飲以助肌肉修復。

examples.en: Blending frozen bananas, oats, and peanut butter makes a nutritious homemade protein shake.
examples.zh: 將冷凍香蕉切片、大燕麥片與濃郁花生醬放入果汁機打勻，即可調配出一杯營養滿點的自製蛋白奶昔。

examples.en: Drinking a protein shake between meals is a convenient way to meet daily dietary protein goals.
examples.zh: 在每日三餐正餐之間穿插飲用一杯高蛋白飲品，是忙碌現代人輕鬆達標每日蛋白質攝取目標的便捷良方。

examples.en: Building muscle mass boosts your daily resting basal metabolism rate.
examples.zh: 增加全身骨骼肌肉量能有效提升日常靜止時的基礎新陳代謝率。

examples.en: Getting adequate deep sleep is critical for regulating hormone levels and healthy metabolism.
examples.zh: 每晚享有充足的高品質深層睡眠，對於穩定人體內分泌荷爾蒙濃度與維持健康新陳代謝不可或缺。

examples.en: Regular brisk walking helps kick-start a sluggish digestive metabolism.
examples.zh: 飯後養成出門快走健走的好習慣，能有效喚醒並啟動因久坐而趨於緩慢遲滯的腸胃消化代謝功能。

examples.en: Regular exercise and clean eating lower body fat percentage steadily.
examples.zh: 規律運動結合乾淨原型食物飲食能循序漸進穩定降低體脂率。

examples.en: Excess visceral body fat surrounding internal organs poses significant cardiovascular risks.
examples.zh: 堆積包覆在腹腔各大內臟器官周遭的過量內臟脂肪，會對人體心血管系統帶來不可忽視的健康隱患。

examples.en: Elite athletes often maintain single-digit body fat levels during peak competitive seasons.
examples.zh: 頂級菁英運動健兒在迎戰重大賽季的高峰期，全身骨骼肌外層的體脂率常年保持在驚人的個位數百分比。

examples.en: Certified personal trainers design customized workout routines for beginners.
examples.zh: 領有國際證照的健身私人教練為剛起步的新手量身打造專屬健身課表。

examples.en: Working out alongside a qualified personal trainer ensures proper lifting form and safety.
examples.zh: 在受過專業培訓的合格私人教練隨側指導下練槓鈴，能確保動作軌跡標準精確並免於運動傷害。

examples.en: She hired a personal trainer to help her regain core strength following spine rehabilitation.
examples.zh: 她在完成脊椎術後物理復健後，專程聘請了一位經驗豐富的私人教練協助她科學恢復深層核心肌力。

examples.en: The 24-hour fitness center offers flexible monthly gym memberships.
examples.zh: 這間二十四小時全天候健身中心提供極具彈性的月繳型健身房會員會籍。

examples.en: He signed up for an annual gym membership as part of his New Year resolution.
examples.zh: 作為自己落實新年健康新希望的一部分，他下定決心報名辦理了一張連鎖健身房年度會員卡。

examples.en: Read the contract cancellation policy carefully before committing to a multi-year gym membership.
examples.zh: 在衝動簽署長達數年的高額健身房綁約會籍合約之前，請務必先看清合約背面的退費與終止條款細則。

words.definition: 跑步機；單調繁重的工作

examples.en: Running on the electric treadmill allows indoor training during rainy days.
examples.zh: 雨天在室內電動跑步機上慢跑讓運動訓練不受天候影響照常進行。

examples.en: You can adjust the incline angle on the motorized treadmill to simulate steep mountain hikes.
examples.zh: 您可以自由調升電動跑步機的坡度揚升角度，在冷氣房內擬真體驗高海拔陡峭登山爬坡訓練。

examples.en: After working non-stop for months, he felt trapped on a relentless corporate treadmill.
examples.zh: 在日復一日無休止高壓加班數月之後，他深切感到自己宛如一隻被困在企業無盡旋轉跑步機上的白老鼠。

examples.en: Perform bicep curls using a pair of eight-kilogram dumbbells.
examples.zh: 使用一對各八公斤的啞鈴進行二頭肌彎舉肌力訓練。

examples.en: Adjustable dumbbells are an excellent space-saving investment for home fitness enthusiasts.
examples.zh: 快速可調重量式組合啞鈴，對於在有限居家空間打造個人健身角落的居家訓練愛好者而言是絕佳投資。

examples.en: Always return dumbbells to the weight rack after completing your strength training sets.
examples.zh: 每次做完重量訓練組數後，請務必發揮公德心隨手將啞鈴物歸原位整齊放回金屬器械架上。

examples.en: Load weighted plates onto the olympic barbell for heavy bench presses.
examples.zh: 將重訓槓片穩穩裝載至奧林匹克槓鈴桿上準備進行大重量臥推。

examples.en: Learning to balance the barbell evenly across your shoulders is fundamental for back squats.
examples.zh: 掌握將重訓槓鈴桿平穩對稱地架在肩背斜方肌上的平衡技巧，是練好槓鈴後深蹲最核心的基本功。

examples.en: The heavy steel barbell dropped onto the rubber floor mat with a loud thud.
examples.zh: 沉重堅硬的實心鋼製槓鈴重重砸落在加厚橡膠防震減噪地墊上，發出了一聲低沉厚重的悶響。

examples.en: Barbell squats target quadriceps, hamstrings, and gluteal muscles effectively.
examples.zh: 槓鈴深蹲能強效針對大腿股四頭肌、後腿肌腱與臀大肌進行全面刺激。

examples.en: Keep your chest up and push through your heels when coming up from a deep squat.
examples.zh: 從底部深蹲動作發力起身時，請務必保持挺胸收腹，並將重心穩固落在腳跟處向上蹬地發力。

examples.en: The catcher in the baseball game had to squat behind home plate for nine full innings.
examples.zh: 棒球比賽中的捕手必須在整個九局正規賽程中，全程長時間維持深蹲半蹲姿勢蹲在本壘板後方。

words.definition: 登山健行運動；高山攀登

examples.en: Taiwan's rugged Central Mountain Range offers world-class mountaineering routes.
examples.zh: 台灣壯麗險峻的中央山脈提供了世界級百岳攀登登山健行路線。

examples.en: Winter mountaineering requires crampons, ice axes, and specialized avalanche rescue beacons.
examples.zh: 挑戰高山雪季冬季高山攀登時，冰爪、冰斧以及專業的雪崩搜救定位訊號器皆為不可或缺的保命裝備。

examples.en: Respecting the unpredictable mountain weather is rule number one in alpine mountaineering.
examples.zh: 發自內心敬畏高山捉摸不定的詭譎天候變化，是從事任何高山攀登探險運動永遠不可違背的第一守則。

examples.en: The well-maintained hiking trail in Yangmingshan offers scenic valley views.
examples.zh: 陽明山國家公園內維護完善的登山步道能飽覽壯麗的火山山谷景致。

examples.en: Signs along the hiking trail indicate distance markers and estimated walking hours.
examples.zh: 沿著國家步道兩側設立的木質指標牌，清楚標註了每一段里程碑距離與預估徒步所需時間。

examples.en: Volunteers spent the weekend repairing eroded stone steps along the historic hiking trail.
examples.zh: 熱心愛山的修路志工利用週末假期，自備工具悉心修復這條百年古道上因雨水沖刷坍塌的砌石階梯。

words.definition: 山頂；最高峰；登頂；高峰會

examples.en: Climbers reached the summit of Yushan (Jade Mountain) just before sunrise.
examples.zh: 登山隊員趕在破曉前夕順利登頂全台最高峰玉山主峰山頂。

examples.en: Standing at the windy mountain summit, hikers cheered as the sea of clouds glowed orange.
examples.zh: 佇立在強風呼嘯的高山峰頂，眼見腳下浩瀚翻滾的雲海在晨曦中鍍上一層金黃，登山客情不自禁熱血歡呼。

examples.en: World leaders assembled in Geneva for a high-stakes bilateral economic summit.
examples.zh: 各國領導人與代表團雲集日內瓦聯合國總部，共同出席一場關乎全球經濟未來走向的雙邊最高層級高峰會。

words.definition: 高山症；高海拔缺氧反應

examples.en: Ascend mountains gradually to prevent headaches caused by altitude sickness.
examples.zh: 登山時採取漸進式上升步調，以有效防範高山症所引發的劇烈頭痛。

examples.en: Symptoms of acute altitude sickness include nausea, dizziness, insomnia, and shortness of breath.
examples.zh: 急性高山症（AMS）的典型發病症狀包括噁心嘔吐、頭重腳輕、夜間輾轉難眠以及呼吸急促急喘。

examples.en: If altitude sickness worsens, the safest and only effective cure is immediate descent to a lower elevation.
examples.zh: 若病患高山症症狀持續惡化，最安全且唯一具備根本療效的救命解方就是果斷立即下撤至低海拔地區。

examples.en: River tracing through Hualien's Golden Canyon includes swimming and cliff jumping.
examples.zh: 在花蓮黃金峽谷進行溯溪探險活動涵蓋了深潭游泳與刺激的跳水挑戰。

examples.en: Wear felt-soled aquatic boots and a certified helmet for protection during river tracing.
examples.zh: 參加溯溪探險時，請務必換穿抓地防滑的專用菜瓜布底溯溪鞋並全程佩戴合格攀岩防護頭盔。

examples.en: Our river tracing expedition navigated turbulent rapids and slippery waterfalls safely.
examples.zh: 我們的溯溪冒險探險隊在資深合格教練的悉心帶領下，順利且平安地征服了湍急白浪與濕滑險峻的瀑布岩壁。

examples.en: Green Island and Kenting are internationally famous for pristine scuba diving.
examples.zh: 綠島與墾丁以其清澈湛藍的海水與世界級水肺潛水景點聞名於世。

examples.en: You must complete classroom theory and open-water dives to obtain your scuba diving license.
examples.zh: 您必須完整修習室內學科理論課程並通過多項開放水域下潛考核，方能順利考取國際水肺潛水執照。

examples.en: While scuba diving, keep a safe distance from delicate corals to avoid damaging the reef ecosystem.
examples.zh: 在進行深海水肺潛水漫遊時，請務必與脆弱的珊瑚礁保持安全距離，堅決避免踢觸破壞海洋生態。

examples.en: Snorkeling in Xiaoliuqiu allows swimmers to observe sea turtles up close.
examples.zh: 在小琉球體驗浮潛讓泳客能近距離靜靜欣賞優雅悠游的野生綠蠵龜。

examples.en: Put on a silicone mask and snorkel tube to breathe easily while looking down at coral reefs.
examples.zh: 戴上貼合臉型的矽膠浮潛面鏡並含緊呼吸管，即可讓您漂浮在海面上輕鬆呼吸、低頭飽覽海底珊瑚世界。

examples.en: Shallow protected lagoons provide a safe, calm environment for beginners trying snorkeling.
examples.zh: 風平浪靜且水深及腰的受庇護淺水潟湖海灣，為剛接觸浮潛的新手提供了極度安全安心的下水環境。

examples.en: Wushi Harbor in Yilan is Taiwan's most popular surfing destination.
examples.zh: 宜蘭頭城烏石港是全台灣人氣最旺且浪況極佳的衝浪運動勝地。

examples.en: Surfing enthusiasts monitor offshore wave forecasts to catch clean swells at sunrise.
examples.zh: 熱愛追浪的衝浪好手每日緊盯專業即時海況浪況預報，只為在破曉日出時分搶先迎接最完美乾淨的定點長浪。

examples.en: Maintaining core balance on a foam surfboard requires patience and practice.
examples.zh: 想要在初學者泡棉軟板上穩穩站起並維持身體核心重心平衡，需要傾注極大的耐心與反覆落水嘗試。

examples.en: Stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) on calm Sun Moon Lake at dawn is magical.
examples.zh: 清晨破曉時分在波平如鏡的日月潭體驗 SUP 立式划槳如夢似幻。

examples.en: Balancing on the wide inflatable paddleboarding board is surprisingly easy for beginners.
examples.zh: 站在寬大厚實的充氣式立式划槳充氣板上維持平衡，對初次下水體驗的新手而言其實出乎意料地容易上手。

examples.en: Coastal resorts offer guided sunset paddleboarding tours along limestone cliffs.
examples.zh: 濱海海濱度假村推出了由合格教練隨行護航的日落黃昏立槳行程，引領遊客沿著壯麗石灰岩懸崖悠閒巡航。

examples.en: Always wear a snug certified life jacket when participating in water sports.
examples.zh: 參與任何水域休閒運動時，請務必全程正確穿妥合格浮力救生衣。

examples.en: The kayak rental operator refuses to rent equipment to anyone not wearing a fastened life jacket.
examples.zh: 獨木舟獨木舟租賃業者明文宣導，凡是未依規定完整穿好並繫緊防護救生衣者，一律嚴詞拒絕租借設備。

examples.en: Bright orange life jackets are equipped with reflective strips for high visibility in open water.
examples.zh: 採用鮮豔亮橘色高辨識度布料縫製的專業救生衣，在雙肩均加貼了高反光條，確保在開闊水域能第一時間被搜救發現。

examples.en: Rock climbers clip ropes securely through forged steel carabiners.
examples.zh: 攀岩好手將主繩索安全確實地扣入高強度鍛造鋼製登山安全扣環中。

examples.en: Always inspect your screw-lock carabiner to confirm the safety gate is tightly fastened.
examples.zh: 在懸空離地前請務必再三檢查旋鎖式安全扣環的保險螺帽，再三確認防脫開口安全閥門已徹底旋緊鎖死。

examples.en: Backpackers clip metal carabiners to their shoulder straps to carry water bottles and sandals.
examples.zh: 戶外背包客常在雙肩背包胸前扣帶上掛上輕巧的鋁合金快扣扣環，隨手扣掛個人環保水壺或拖鞋。

words.definition: 登山頭燈；頭戴式手電筒

examples.en: A reliable waterproof LED headlamp is mandatory for overnight alpine treks.
examples.zh: 一支性能可靠且防水的 LED 登山頭燈是進行高山過夜縱走必備裝備。

examples.en: Switching your headlamp to red-light mode preserves night vision inside shared camping tents.
examples.zh: 在多人共享的山屋帳篷內休息時，請主動將頭戴式登山頭燈切換為暗紅光模式，既照明又保護他人夜視力。

examples.en: Always pack extra lithium batteries or a portable power bank for your rechargeable headlamp.
examples.zh: 攀登百岳高山前，千萬切記要為您的充電式高流明頭燈在背包急救包中多預備一組鋰電池或行動電源。

words.definition: 喜愛冒險的；充滿刺激的

examples.en: Adventurous backpackers explore uncharted mountain trails with enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 充滿冒險探索精神的背包客懷抱無限熱忱探訪鮮為人知的秘境山徑。

examples.en: Trying exotic street delicacies in night markets is fun for adventurous foodies.
examples.zh: 勇於大膽品嚐夜市各類在地罕見特色街頭風味小吃，對於熱愛冒險的美食老饕而言是一大人生樂事。

examples.en: She lived an adventurous life, solo backpacking across fifty different countries on five continents.
examples.zh: 她擁有令人艷羨的精彩冒險人生，曾獨自一人揹著行囊單槍匹馬闖蕩遊歷了全球五大洲的五十多個國家。
